R341.note: Raw socket swapped for EnyimMemcachedCore Store() API which length-prefixes/validates the key; constructor change to IMemcachedClient is stated plainly.

R342.note: Field allowlist checked before interpolation into the identifier position; term stays bound; default 'name' still passes.

R343.note: Narrow DTO excludes IsAdmin/Balance from gob decode; server sets them explicitly; wire format preserved.

R344.note: Allowlist gates the plugin name before require(); default 'summary' included.

R345.note: Wrapping ruleSource in '(function(){return(...)})' does not sandbox anything: the engine has Java interop, so an attacker can still embed a fully-formed IIFE calling java.lang.Runtime/ProcessBuilder as a plain expression inside the parens. Arbitrary code execution is still reachable.

R346.note: Standard parameterized query with sqlite3 placeholder; customer_id passed as bound tuple value.

R347.note: findByOwnerUsername() confirmed to exist on the repository; mirrors the detail endpoint's pattern exactly.

R348.note: isOwnedBy() is a stub hardcoded to return false, so as written every delete (including the legitimate owner's) is denied with AccessDeniedException; write-up presents this as the fix without flagging that it blocks all real deletes, contradicting the contract that owners can still delete.

R349.note: Wraps route with the existing requireAdmin middleware, matching sibling routes exactly.

R350.note: Allowlist maps command verb to a fixed handler function name; call_user_func_array only ever receives the vetted handler.

R351.note: Builds a correct RESP bulk-string encoded command so locale cannot inject CRLF-delimited commands; preserves the same HSET fields.

R352.note: Replaces the injected call target with a fabricated stored procedure name ('someStoredProc') that does not exist anywhere in the case; parameterization concept is right but every legitimate call would now fail at execution with no such procedure, and this isn't flagged.

R353.note: Correct ODBC parameterized query; LIKE wildcards kept in the bound value as literal data.

R354.note: Fully closes eval-based injection, but discards the contract entirely: Evaluate() no longer accepts an arithmetic rule using orderTotal/lookupRate at all (LookupRate becomes dead code, never called from Evaluate), replaced by a fixed named-rule dictionary. Write-up falsely claims 'existing callers of Evaluate() continue to work unchanged.'

R355.note: Removes template.HTML cast so html/template's default context-aware escaping applies.

R356.note: realpath()-based canonical containment check correctly blocks absolute paths and traversal before the read.

R357.note: Narrow SafeJob DTO excludes IsAdmin from gob decode; server hardcodes IsAdmin=false; Command/Priority preserved.

R358.note: execFileSync with argument array avoids the shell entirely; geometry regex matches the case's expected 'WxH' format.

R359.note: Optional<Long> makes the null case explicit; orElse(0L) matches the contract's 'no discount / not applied' default at both call sites.

R360.note: snprintf with size check rejects oversized names instead of truncating/overflowing, matching the contract exactly.

R361.note: FileInfo/DirectoryInfo canonical containment check correctly rejects escapes before the read.

R362.note: Restores signature verification with a pinned HS256 algorithm and a required secret; fails closed if unset.

R363.note: IsInRole("Admin") matches the AuthorizeView Roles="Admin" already used to gate rendering; adds the missing server-side check the handler lacked.

R364.note: Single-flag fix to setSecure(true); no other observable change.

R365.note: basename check plus Express's own root-option containment; standard, correct combination.

R366.note: Correct standard fix (GET to POST for a state-changing op under CSRF protection), but this requires every legitimate caller to switch HTTP method and start sending a CSRF token; the write-up states this openly as the necessary consequence.

R367.note: JavaScriptStringEncode is the correct context-specific encoder for a value embedded in a JS string literal.

R368.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet uses RESP length-prefixed encoding, closing the delimiter-injection vector; behavior preserved.

R369.note: Placeholder + bound array parameter closes the injection; execute() vs query() distinction in the explanation is factually shaky but doesn't affect correctness of the fix itself.

R370.note: Eliminates BinaryFormatter risk, but silently swaps the wire format (binary-serialized blob to JSON) and the cached object's type (arbitrary session object to JsonElement); any real producer of binary-serialized session blobs, or consumer expecting a typed session from the cache, breaks without this being disclosed.

R371.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities() applied at the source before interpolation; downstream print statement unchanged and safe.

R372.note: JNDI parameterized search filter with {0} placeholder lets the provider RFC-4515-escape the value; SearchControls() default matches the original's implicit OBJECT_SCOPE behavior.

R373.note: Adds the missing offset+length bound with underflow-safe ordering, matching the contract exactly.

R374.note: Rejects any filename containing separators or '..' before path construction, closing the realpath-on-missing-file bypass; canonical check is redundant but harmless.

R375.note: ObjectInputFilter.Config.createFilter("cases.deserialize.RestoredSession") has no trailing '!*' reject-all clause; per JEP 290 semantics, classes that don't match any pattern return UNDECIDED and are still allowed absent a process-wide filter, so gadget-chain classes remain deserializable and the vulnerability is not actually closed.

R376.note: Switching {!! !!} to {{ }} blanket-escapes all HTML, but the contract requires sanitization that lets allowed formatting survive while only scripts/handlers/dangerous URLs are stripped; this silently removes all rich-text formatting instead, which isn't flagged.

R377.note: Same correct DTO-narrowing fix as R357 for the identical case; IsAdmin excluded from decode and hardcoded false server-side.

R378.note: Scheme blocklist plus host allowlist for absolute/scheme-relative URIs, while relative paths (null host) pass through unchanged; standard open-redirect fix.

R379.note: filepath.Base() strips any directory components from the uploaded filename before join, closing the traversal cleanly.

R380.note: expr-eval closes the code-injection vector, but parsed.evaluate(order) passes the order object's own fields as the top-level scope instead of nesting it under an 'order' key; since expressions use member access like order.total, evaluate() would throw 'order is not defined' for every legitimate formula in the contract's own example, and this break isn't disclosed.
